verdict.rationale: Bulk actions are a fair question for an authenticator or password manager, but nothing in the evidence documents selecting many tokens or Items and acting on them together (bulk edit, delete, move or regroup). Importing from other apps and exporting files are migration features from a different story, and the llms.txt probe confirms 'Public API: None', so there is no programmatic route to batch operations either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
